inspector.name: Name
inspector.videoGroupNote: Keeps the full frame. Applies to compatible software video; automatic mode uses native HEVC when supported by your browser. Changing the profile restarts only the video stream.
inspector.cpuWarning: If you notice lag or high CPU usage, switch to Balanced or Economy.
inspector.recordingIncludeAudioDetail: Mix live USB audio into saved recordings when PC audio is active
inspector.recordingNote: Direct hardware or YUV software capture at up to 60 FPS with adaptive audio drift correction.
inspector.reduceMotionDetail: Replaces zoom animations with crossfades to maintain full HEVC resolution
inspector.reduceTransparencyDetail: Disables iOS blur effects for sharper text and smoother encoding
inspector.increaseContrastDetail: Improves border and button legibility on the iPhone display
inspector.iosPerfNote: Applied live on the iPhone via CoreDevice. Enabling "Reduce Motion" prevents the iOS hardware encoder from dropping resolution during app switches.
inspector.camMicAutoPaused: Auto-paused · Camera or microphone in use on iOS
inspector.camMicManualPaused: Capture paused · Sensors available on iOS
inspector.camMicAutoDetail: Triggers automatically when opening Camera or Voice Memos
inspector.camMicNote: iOS locks the camera and microphone during screen capture (CoreDevice 9022). MirrOS automatically switches to the live DVT viewfinder when Camera or Voice Memos is opened and resumes 60 FPS screen capture when closed.
inspector.autoDimOnConnectDetail: Runs iOS Shortcuts to dim the OLED screen on connect and restore on disconnect
inspector.dimGuideSummary: How to set up the 2 iOS Shortcuts (1 min)
inspector.dimGuideIntro: iOS only allows changing Reduce White Point and reading exact Brightness via Apple Shortcuts. The video in MirrOS stays at 100% brightness while your iPhone screen turns nearly pitch black.
inspector.dimGuideStep1Body: Check if file mirros_brightness.txt exists in iCloud Drive/Shortcuts; if not, Get Device Details (Current Brightness) → Save File as mirros_brightness.txt. Then: Set White Point → Turn On, and Set Brightness → 0%.
inspector.dimGuideStep2Body: Get File mirros_brightness.txt (ignore error if missing). If it has any value: Set White Point → Turn Off, Set Brightness → File, and Delete File mirros_brightness.txt.
inspector.dimGuideStep3Body: In Shortcuts → Automation → Personal Automation → Charger (Is Disconnected, Run Immediately) → Run Shortcut "MirrOS Restore". On normal wall chargers the file does not exist so it does nothing; if you unplug MirrOS abruptly, your screen restores automatically.
inspector.aodDesc: Lets the physical iPhone display rest in AOD while you keep viewing and controlling it on your PC. Click "Wake iPhone display" (or Ctrl + U) to return to Dual Screen.
inspector.dualDesc: Dual Screen: keeps the physical iPhone display on simultaneously with the PC window.
inspector.sessionNote: Releases keyboard and touch state before unplugging the USB cable. Closing MirrOS also ends the session cleanly.
inspector.orientationNote: The view follows iOS orientation automatically. This button also rotates the canvas when an app stays locked in portrait.
inspector.actionsNote: Keep the iPhone awake for continuous capture. Wake does not bypass Face ID or the iOS passcode.
inspector.mouseHint: Click to tap and drag to swipe. Right-click returns to the Home Screen.
inspector.audioOutputNote: Uses the default audio output device on {platform}.
inspector.iphoneAudioNote: Status is shown on iOS. Hardware mute may not silence media playback.
inspector.audioTip: To listen only on the iPhone speaker, turn off PC audio.
inspector.clipboardShortcutsNote: Focus the iPhone screen to use shortcuts. Copy and paste normally in your PC apps. Supports Unicode text and PNG images.
inspector.clipboardBusyStatus: Preparing clipboard… iOS may take a moment with rich app content.
inspector.pcToIphoneSub: Send what you copied on your PC
inspector.iphoneToPcSub: Fetch what you copied on your iPhone
inspector.transferringNote: Transferring… iOS may take up to 90 seconds for large items.
inspector.transferReadyNote: Supports text and images. Then paste in the destination app.
inspector.sendTextNote: Tap a text field on the iPhone first.
inspector.clipboardPrivacyNote: The clipboard is only accessed when you explicitly copy or paste. Never read in the background.
inspector.pointerNote: Only changes the visual indicator. Touch coordinates sent to the iPhone keep full precision.
inspector.step1: Connect your iPhone with a USB data cable.
inspector.step2: Unlock the iPhone and tap "Trust This Computer".
inspector.step3: Enable Developer Mode in Settings → Privacy & Security.
inspector.diagnosticsNote: Exported JSON includes software versions and USB availability without UDIDs, device names, or clipboard contents.
